label: Tokens
description: What a sign-in or a refresh answers: a short-lived access token to present on gated triggers, the refresh token that renews it once, when it expires, and the session both belong to.

accessToken.description: a signed JWT; present it where a trigger's policy attachment reads it (Authorization: Bearer ..., a cookie, --token=)

refreshToken.description: opaque, single-use: token.port.json#refresh trades it for a new pair and voids it

expiresIn.description: seconds until the access token expires
